key.name: palette
key.description: The name of the color palette to use.

key.name: color-scheme
key.description: Use the light or the dark variant of the palette, or follow the system.

key.name: restore-session
key.description: Reopen the windows and tabs of the last session when the app starts.

key.name: tab-folders
key.summary: Folders shown in the title of a tab
key.description: How many of the last folders of a path the title of a tab shows. 0 shows the whole path. The tooltip always has it.

key.name: prompt-folders
key.summary: Folders shown in the shell prompt
key.description: How many of the last folders of the current directory the prompt of a new shell shows, for shells that follow PROMPT_DIRTRIM, like bash. 0 shows the whole path.

key.name: highlight-running
key.summary: Highlight tabs while a command is running

key.name: font
key.description: The font to use when the system font is not used.

key.name: bold-is-bright
key.description: Show bold text in the bright variant of its color.

key.name: zoom
key.description: The zoom level of the text, shared by all terminals and remembered between sessions.

key.name: scroll-on-keystroke
key.summary: Scroll to the bottom when a key is pressed

key.name: scroll-on-output
key.summary: Scroll to the bottom when there is new output

key.name: limit-scrollback
key.summary: Limit the number of lines saved for scrollback

key.name: visual-bell
key.description: Flash the headerbar, or mark the tab if it is in the background, when a program rings the bell.

key.name: shell
key.description: The path of the shell to run, one of those listed in /etc/shells. Empty means the user's default shell.

key.name: startup-command
key.description: A command typed into each new terminal when it starts. The shell stays open afterwards.
